harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: On node1 (RHEL 9.8), built a local yum/dnf package repository under /srv/localrepo (createrepo_c, package: tree-1.8.0-10.el9.x86_64.rpm), served it via a persistent systemd-managed python3 http.server on port 8080 bound to NODE_IP, registered it as a dnf repo (localrepo.repo). Blocked the real remote RHEL repo host (cdn.redhat.com, both IPv4/IPv6) via iptables/ip6tables REJECT rules, proved with curl that the remote repo was unreachable, then installed the tree package using only the local repo (--disablerepo=rhel-9-* --enablerepo=localrepo) while remote repos were unreachable. Verified installation via rpm -q and tree --version. Restored network access afterward (removed firewall rules, confirmed remote reachable again) while local repo and installed package remained in place. Completed the mandatory node-restart evidence protocol: captured baseline boot_id and service/data health, issued `systemctl reboot`, polled until exec was available again, confirmed a changed boot_id (377b5195... -> fd9bd437...), and verified the local repo HTTP service, local repo content, dnf repo registration, and the installed tree package all recovered post-restart.
actions_performed: Inspected node1 OS/repo state and confirmed no createrepo tooling or cached RPMs present
Installed createrepo_c and downloaded tree-1.8.0-10.el9.x86_64.rpm via dnf while remote repos were reachable
Created /srv/localrepo, copied the RPM in, ran createrepo_c to build repo metadata
Created and enabled a systemd unit (localrepo-http.service) serving /srv/localrepo via python3 http.server on 0.0.0.0:8080, opened firewalld port 8080
Registered /etc/yum.repos.d/localrepo.repo pointing at http://$NODE_IP:8080/
Resolved cdn.redhat.com IPv4/IPv6 addresses and blocked port 443 to them via iptables/ip6tables REJECT rules
Verified remote repo unreachable via curl (connection refused)
Removed tree (confirmed absent) then installed tree via dnf using only the localrepo (remote repos disabled/unreachable)
Verified installation with rpm -q tree and tree --version
Removed the iptables/ip6tables block and confirmed remote connectivity restored while local repo/package remained intact
Captured pre-restart baseline (boot_id, service status, installed package, repo HTTP reachability)
Issued systemctl reboot on node1, polled until exec access returned
Verified changed boot_id and confirmed local repo service, repo content, dnf registration, and installed package all recovered post-restart

evidence.requirement: Serve a package repository from local storage on node1
evidence.summary: createrepo_c built repo metadata in /srv/localrepo; systemd unit localrepo-http.service started and became active, serving repodata over HTTP on NODE_IP:8080 (verified repomd.xml fetch)
iptables/ip6tables REJECT rules installed against cdn.redhat.com's IPv4/IPv6 addresses; curl to the remote repo URL failed with 'Connection refused' (exit 7), proving unreachability

evidence.requirement: Install a package from the local repository while remote repos are unreachable
evidence.summary: With remote host blocked, dnf install with rhel-9-* repos disabled and only localrepo enabled installed tree successfully; rpm -q tree and tree --version confirmed the binary works

evidence.requirement: Restore environment / remote reachability after demonstration (reversible disruption)
evidence.summary: Firewall REJECT rules removed (OUTPUT chain empty); TLS handshake to cdn.redhat.com succeeded again (403 from proxy, same as pre-block state); local repo and installed tree package remained intact

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: healthy baseline before restart
evidence.summary: Captured baseline boot_id 377b5195-7fea-4219-a67b-044ef3f7ab99, localrepo-http.service active, tree installed, local repo HTTP reachable (200), rpm file present
systemctl reboot issued in background; exec stream closed as node1 went down, consistent with an in-progress restart

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: changed boot identity proven
evidence.summary: After polling through connection timeouts, exec became available again and boot_id read fd9bd437-8c76-40a0-9378-bd3d47a3df64, differing from the pre-restart baseline

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: post-restart recovery of services and data
evidence.summary: Post-restart: boot_id confirmed changed, localrepo-http.service active again (auto-started), tree package still installed and functional, local repo HTTP still serving 200, dnf repolist still shows localrepo
